# technitium_zone (Resource)

Manages an authoritative zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_zone" "home" {
  zone = "home.example.com"
}

# A Forwarder zone starts empty; its forwarders are FWD records at the apex.
resource "technitium_zone" "reverse" {
  zone = "178.168.192.in-addr.arpa"
  type = "Forwarder"
}

resource "technitium_record_fwd" "reverse" {
  zone      = technitium_zone.reverse.zone
  domain    = technitium_zone.reverse.zone
  forwarder = "192.168.178.2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The zone name. An IP address or a network in CIDR notation creates the matching reverse zone.

### Optional

- `catalog` (String) The catalog zone this zone is a member of. Applies to `Primary`, `Secondary`, `Stub` and `Forwarder` zones.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable the zone without deleting it.
- `notify` (String) Which name servers to notify of zone changes. `Primary` and `Secondary` zones accept `None`, `ZoneNameServers`, `SpecifiedNameServers` or `BothZoneAndSpecifiedNameServers`. `Forwarder` and `Catalog` zones accept `None` or `SpecifiedNameServers`, and `Catalog` zones also `SeparateNameServersForCatalogAndMemberZones`.
- `notify_name_servers` (List of String) The IP addresses to notify of zone changes when `notify` is `SpecifiedNameServers` or `BothZoneAndSpecifiedNameServers`. Applies to `Primary`, `Secondary`, `Forwarder` and `Catalog` zones.
- `notify_secondary_catalogs_name_servers` (List of String) The IP addresses to notify of catalog zone changes only, when `notify` is `SeparateNameServersForCatalogAndMemberZones`. Applies to `Catalog` zones.
- `override_catalog_notify` (Boolean) Use this zone's `notify` instead of the catalog zone's. Applies to `Primary` and `Forwarder` zones.
- `override_catalog_query_access` (Boolean) Use this zone's `query_access` instead of the catalog zone's. Applies to `Primary`, `Secondary`, `Stub` and `Forwarder` zones.
- `override_catalog_zone_transfer` (Boolean) Use this zone's `zone_transfer` instead of the catalog zone's. Applies to `Primary`, `Secondary` and `Forwarder` zones.
- `primary_name_server_addresses` (List of String) The IP addresses or domain names of the primary name servers. Applies to `Secondary`, `SecondaryForwarder`, `SecondaryCatalog` and `Stub` zones, and is required for `SecondaryForwarder` and `SecondaryCatalog`. When unset, `Secondary` and `Stub` zones resolve them through the zone's name servers. With `primary_zone_transfer_protocol` set to `Tls` or `Quic`, include the port, for example `192.0.2.1:853`: the server adds it otherwise, which Terraform reports as an inconsistent result.
- `primary_zone_transfer_protocol` (String) The protocol for transferring the zone from its primary: `Tcp`, `Tls` or `Quic`. Applies to `Secondary`, `SecondaryForwarder` and `SecondaryCatalog` zones.
- `primary_zone_transfer_tsig_key_name` (String) The TSIG key for transferring the zone from its primary, one of the keys in `technitium_settings_tsig`. Applies to `Secondary`, `SecondaryForwarder` and `SecondaryCatalog` zones.
- `query_access` (String) Who may query the zone: `Deny`, `Allow`, `AllowOnlyPrivateNetworks`, `AllowOnlyZoneNameServers`, `UseSpecifiedNetworkACL` or `AllowZoneNameServersAndUseSpecifiedNetworkACL`.
- `query_access_network_acl` (List of String) The networks that may query the zone when `query_access` uses a network ACL. Each entry is an IP address or network; prefix it with `!` to deny it. Entries are checked in order, and anything unmatched is denied except loopback. An empty list clears it. Applies to all zones except `SecondaryCatalog`.
- `type` (String) The zone type: `Primary` (default), `Secondary`, `Stub`, `Forwarder`, `SecondaryForwarder`, `Catalog` or `SecondaryCatalog`. A `Forwarder` zone starts empty: add its forwarders as `technitium_record_fwd` resources with `domain` set to the zone name.
- `update` (String) Who may send dynamic updates (RFC 2136). `Primary` zones accept `Deny`, `Allow`, `AllowOnlyZoneNameServers`, `UseSpecifiedNetworkACL` or `AllowZoneNameServersAndUseSpecifiedNetworkACL`. `Secondary` and `Forwarder` zones accept `Deny`, `Allow` or `UseSpecifiedNetworkACL`.
- `update_network_acl` (List of String) The networks that may send dynamic updates when `update` uses a network ACL. Each entry is an IP address or network; prefix it with `!` to deny it. Entries are checked in order, and anything unmatched is denied. An empty list clears it. Applies to `Primary`, `Secondary` and `Forwarder` zones.
- `update_security_policies` (Attributes Set) Which records each TSIG key may change through dynamic updates, one entry per key and domain. An empty set removes the policies and turns off TSIG authentication for updates. Applies to `Primary` and `Forwarder` zones. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--update_security_policies))
- `zone_transfer` (String) Who may transfer the zone: `Deny`, `Allow`, `AllowOnlyZoneNameServers`, `UseSpecifiedNetworkACL` or `AllowZoneNameServersAndUseSpecifiedNetworkACL`. Applies to `Primary` and `Secondary` zones.
- `zone_transfer_network_acl` (List of String) The networks that may transfer the zone when `zone_transfer` uses a network ACL. Each entry is an IP address or network; prefix it with `!` to deny it. Entries are checked in order, and anything unmatched is denied. An empty list clears it. Applies to `Primary`, `Secondary`, `Forwarder` and `Catalog` zones.
- `zone_transfer_tsig_key_names` (List of String) The TSIG keys allowed to transfer the zone. An empty list clears it. Applies to `Primary`, `Secondary`, `Forwarder` and `Catalog` zones.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--update_security_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `update_security_policies`

Required:

- `allowed_types` (List of String) The record types the key may change, in upper case, for example `A` and `AAAA`.
- `domain` (String) The domain name in the zone the key may change, in lower case. A wildcard such as `*.example.com` covers all its subdomains.
- `tsig_key_name` (String) The TSIG key, one of the keys in `technitium_settings_tsig`, in lower case.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_zone.home home.example.com
```
